Description: A bill to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 to provide that the investment tax credit shall be allowable with respect to certain small boilers fueled by oil or gas.
To provide that the people of the Virgin Islands be represented by a Delegate in the House of Representatives of the United States
To establish the National Commission to Aid Homeless Mentally Ill Individuals.
To authorize the apportionment of officers retirement pay in certain cases
To amend section 107(x) (3) and section 107(x)(4) of the Soil Bank Act and section 407 of the Agricultural Act of 1949
